item.title: [Feature Request] Lifecycle hooks for Builder/Agent mode
item.body:
## Feature Request: Lifecycle Hooks

**What**: Add lifecycle hooks to Trae's Builder/Agent mode — user-defined commands that fire on agent events (session start/stop, tool use, prompt submission, etc.).

**How it works**: When an event occurs, Trae spawns a subprocess, pipes event metadata as JSON to stdin, and optionally reads a JSON response from stdout. Configuration via `settings.json` or a dedicated hooks config file.

### Why this matters

This pattern is now standard across CLI coding agents:

| Tool | Hooks support |
|------|--------------|
| Claude Code | ✅ `~/.claude/settings.json` |
| OpenAI Codex | ✅ `~/.codex/hooks.json` |
| Gemini CLI | ✅ `~/.gemini/settings.json` |
| **Cursor** | ✅ `~/.cursor/hooks.json` |
| Copilot CLI | ✅ `~/.copilot/config.json` |
| Qoder (Alibaba) | ✅ `~/.qoder/settings.json` |
| CodeBuddy (Tencent) | ✅ `~/.codebuddy/settings.json` |

20+ external tools are built on this protocol — status panels, sound notifications, usage trackers, custom approval flows. Without hooks, Trae is invisible to this ecosystem.

### Suggested events

- `SessionStart` / `SessionStop`
- `UserPromptSubmit`
- `PreToolUse` / `PostToolUse` (with tool name + input)

### Context

I build [Vibe Island](https://vibeisland.app), a macOS notch panel for coding agents. Currently supports 9 CLI tools. Would love to add Trae support — hooks are the only missing piece.

---

## 功能请求：生命周期 Hooks

希望 Trae 的 Builder/Agent 模式支持 **生命周期 hooks** —— 在 agent 事件发生时（会话开始/结束、工具调用、提交 prompt 等）触发用户自定义命令。

这个模式已经是 CLI 编码工具的行业标准：Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、**Cursor**、Copilot、通义灵码(Qoder)、CodeBuddy 都已支持。基于这个协议已经有 20+ 外部工具（状态面板、音效通知、用量追踪、自定义审批流）。

没有 hooks，Trae 对整个生态是不可见的。加上 hooks 就能零成本接入所有这些工具。
